newsitem.title: NEPAL: Five die in clash between Nepal police and militants.
newsitem.headline: Five die in clash between Nepal police and militants.

text.p: Five people were killed and two injured in a clash between suspected Maoist militants and police in eastern Nepal, officials said on Saturday.
A Home (Interior) Ministry spokesman told Reuters about 300 guerrillas attacked a police post at Bethan village in Ramechhap district late on Friday.
Police returned fire, killing three insurgents, spokesman Gopendra Bahadur Pandey said. Two policemen were killed by the militants, who set the guard post on fire.
Authorities said police reinforcements were sent to the village in a remote area where there has been a spate of attacks by Maoists opposed to the kingdom's parliamentary democracy.
The insurgents say they want to establish a government of the working class.
Authorities said 79 people have been killed in various parts of Nepal since the insurgency began last February.
